posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Having all 3 different platings out, would reduce all 11 types of damage by 2. This Defensive Blast would do 11 instances of damage as it would (without buffs) be 1 melee, 1 projectile, 1 toxic, 1 fire, 1 energy, 1 cold, 1 lightning, 1 sonic, 1 psychic, 1 infernal, and 1 radiant damage to all target.

posts.name: dragon2439
posts.cooked: I thought the platings bounced to your hand when you played another one. Wouldnt fixed point not apply?
posts.raw: I thought the platings bounced to your hand when you played another one. Wouldnt fixed point not apply?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Fixed Point makes all other cards other than itself indestructible. Indestructible includes being removed from play, thus playing a second plating would attempt to move the first plating from play back into hand, but as it is indestructible it wouldn't be able to.
posts.raw: Fixed Point makes all other cards other than itself indestructible. Indestructible includes being removed from play, thus playing a second plating would attempt to move the first plating from play back into hand, but as it is indestructible it wouldn't be able to.
